imports/startup/client/bootstrap.js: Runtime-only theme and Popper bootstrap driven by Meteor startup, login reactivity, and delayed dynamic imports.
imports/startup/client/errors.js: Global browser and Blaze exception hooks are exercised by the deterministic full-app run, not imported into isolated unit tests.
imports/startup/client/fontawesome.js: Runtime-only delayed dynamic imports for the Font Awesome bundles have no application behavior to unit test.
imports/startup/client/serviceWorker.js: Service-worker registration depends on the real browser lifecycle and is exercised only by the full-app architecture.
imports/startup/client/videos.js: Startup video loading performs an immediate server method call; the underlying context methods and publication are covered separately.
imports/startup/server/collection2.js: Declarative package-only startup import with no application-owned behavior or observable export.
imports/startup/server/content.js: Retained legacy content registrar is not loaded by server/main and would duplicate the active contentContexts registrations.
imports/startup/server/csp.js: Thin Meteor.startup adapter; configureCSP directives and middleware wiring are covered through its extracted boundary.
imports/startup/server/logging.js: One-line external HTTP debug-hook registration with no application-owned decision logic.
imports/startup/server/monitoring.js: One-line external uptime package initialization whose route lifecycle belongs to that package.
imports/startup/server/syncContent.js: Remote startup orchestration is skipped by the deterministic full-app run; ContentServer synchronization behavior is covered with an injected transport.
